derivation: from H7185 (קָשָׁה) in the sense of knotting up round and hard;
def: something turned (rounded), i.e. a curl (of tresses)

occurrences.text: And it shall come to pass, that instead of sweet smell there shall be stink; and instead of a girdle a rent; and instead of well set hair baldness; and instead of a stomacher a girding of sackcloth; and burning instead of beauty.
